files.rationale: Route Handler implementing the single-item endpoints (update/delete) for item notes
Add functions for updating and deleting item notes to the API service
Update the frontend to clear the input field after successfully adding a note

summary: Implementing the human revision request to add edit and delete functionality for item notes, and to clear the input field after adding a note. This requires adding PUT and DELETE route handlers for item notes, updating the frontend to clear the input field, and modifying the API service to support these new operations.
